title: US equity markets close early at 1:00 p.m. ET — the day after Thanksgiving, the only NYSE early close in all of 2027, and the last session before the December FOMC blackout opens
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars re-fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this lane (HTTP 200 after its 302 — the page needs curl -L — 109,180 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell. The page states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028'; its Thanksgiving Day row gives 'Thursday, November 25***' for 2027, and footnote *** reads verbatim: 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Friday, November 27, 2026, Friday, November 26, 2027, and Friday, November 24, 2028 (the day after Thanksgiving). NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m. All times are Eastern Time.' The 2027 date is READ, not derived. Independently reproduced by statute and weekday arithmetic: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Thanksgiving on the FOURTH Thursday in November, the fourth Thursday of November 2027 is 2027-11-25, and the day after is Friday 2027-11-26. BOND SIDE NOW CLAIMED, correcting the proposal this entry promotes: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule re-fetched the same session (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) DOES carry its 2027 US panel inside the page's own RSC payload — the proposal read only the rendered 2026 tab and recorded the 2027 side as unavailable. The 2027 US card reads verbatim 'Thanksgiving Day | Thursday, November 25, 2027 | Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, November 26, 2027', so SIFMA recommends a 14:00 ET fixed-income close on this date and bonds outlive equities by an hour. Filed estimate on the same count thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 and good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 documented: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs has no slot for an exchange operator's or a trade association's own hours page, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence
notes: CANONICAL file written by this event's own never-assessed initial research (2026-09-08), promoting proposals/thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26.from-fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27.json per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md; the proposal is now shadowed and stays where it is. Schema follows thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 exactly — kind 'sector', impact low, symbols [], estimate with a NEWS: source — and invents no new kind. WHY THIS HALF DAY EARNS A ROW, two counts, both re-verified from primaries this session. FIRST: it is the ONLY NYSE early close in calendar 2027. The page carries exactly three early-close footnotes — ** is Monday July 3 2028, *** is Nov 27 2026 / Nov 26 2027 / Nov 24 2028, **** is Thursday Dec 24 2026 — and 2027's remaining holidays fall so that no other early close arises: July 4 2027 is a Sunday so Independence Day is observed as a full closure Monday July 5, and Christmas Day 2027 is a Saturday so it is observed as a full closure Friday Dec 24. 2026 has two half sessions and 2028 has two; 2027 has this one. SECOND: it is the deadline session of the December 2027 FOMC blackout, which opens 2027-11-27 (fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27) — the last session on which any FOMC participant may speak on record before the year's final meeting is three and a half hours long. That lane measured only 4 of 167 gates since 2007 with this geometry. CONSEQUENCE RECORDED, NOT TRADED: no US tape reaction should be read off 2027-11-26 as though it were a full session. The ledger measures the thinness (SPY volume median 0.429x its trailing-20 median across 33 day-after-Thanksgiving sessions, 27 of 33 under 0.70x) and, new this session, REFRAMES the vol claim the 2026 sibling registered: a VIX uptick on this session is not a Black Friday anomaly but an instance of a general post-holiday rebound measured at 213 of 302 first-sessions-after-a-holiday up (70.5%) against a 45.6% weekday-matched base, p ~ 2e-18. Impact is LOW and symbols is empty: this is a market-structure fact that changes how other events are READ, not an event with its own directional content. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
